page.overview:
Who is Fubuki Kakuyoku?

Ten years prior to the movie plot, Fubuki participated in overthrowing the daimyō of the Land of Snow, Sōsetsu Kazahana, on the orders of Dotō Kazahana.

Fubiki was a proud and confident individual bordering on arrogant, near constantly smirking even while in combat, and reminding her opponent not to underestimate the Yuki shinobi.

Fubuki was a curvaceous woman with green eyes and lilac spiky hair that stuck out of two holes at the top of her grey helmet, reminiscent of pigtails. She has small circular dark pink eyebrows. Much like her teammates, she wore Chakra Armour.

Fubuki, like the rest of her team, used Ice Release, though this version wasn't a kekkei genkai as they had to use pre-existing ice for their techniques. Fubuki used Ice Release to pull pillars of ice out of the ground to imprison her opponents or defend against attacks. She could also create flying ice needles that she can remotely control. She wore Chakra Armour, which protected her from ninjutsu and genjutsu, as well as amplified her own chakra. Hers, in particular, had built in wings that allowed her to glide around at high speeds.
